answer: Every claim climbs the timber of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the inlet re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the garden of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
